page.layout: Running head top centre "ANNORVM.", page number top right. Below: a header in two lines across the top. Then one table of seven columns (years before Julian era, golden number, Olympiad, year of Rome, dominical letter, Nabonassar era, feriae), with marginal dashes and small notes ("Nou.", "Oct.") in the feriae column. Below the table: one footnote "a" in small type, with a gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: Anni ante | Aur. | An.Olym- | An. Vrb. | Litera | Nabo- | Feriae,
ord.Iul. | num. | piadici. | cond. | domin. | nafari [?]. |
main_text.p: a In annum ducentesimum sexagesimum septimum ante ordinationem Iulianam, kalendis Octobris

page.notes: The table is mostly clear. Uncertain: the column heading "nafari" (read as Nabonassari) and the header "Nabo•" are marked [?] or left as printed. The mark "13—I" in row 247 and "12—I" in row 228 are read as printed, with the dash and roman numeral. The footnote's line break is "ducentesimum sexagesimum septimum", not hyphenated in the scan as far as I can tell. Ruled dashes in the feriae column are rules, not text, and are not transcribed. The "a" mark at the start of the footnote is a note label.
